definitions.explanation: Something undesirable happening frequently or in quick succession. Typically used for accidents, incidents, disasters, or problems.

examples.japanese: ⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{頻発|ひんぱつ}⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{交差点|こうさてん}→交差点：01404_kousaten⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{交通|こうつう}{事故|じこ}→交通事故：21255_koutsuujiko⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{頻発|ひんぱつ}⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Traffic accidents occur frequently at this intersection.

examples.japanese: ⟦{近年|きんねん}→近年：14349_kinnen⟧、⟦{異常|いじょう}{気象|きしょう}→異常気象：18874_ijoukishou⟧⟦による→による：28349_niyoru⟧⟦{自然|しぜん}{災害|さいがい}→自然災害：29290_shizensaigai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{頻発|ひんぱつ}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧おり、⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{急|きゅう}がれて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: In recent years, natural disasters caused by abnormal weather have been occurring frequently, and countermeasures are urgently needed.

notes:
Almost exclusively used for negative events — accidents, crimes, disasters, problems. Would not normally be used for positive occurrences.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{頻発|ひんぱつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (accidents occur frequently)
- ⟦{犯罪|はんざい}→犯罪：03569_hanzai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{頻発|ひんぱつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (crimes occur frequently)
- ⟦{災害|さいがい}→災害：09636_saigai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{頻発|ひんぱつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (disasters occur frequently)
- ⟦トラブル→トラブル：07061_toraburu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{頻発|ひんぱつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (problems occur frequently)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{多発|たはつ}→多発：20508_tahatsu⟧ also means frequent occurrence but is slightly more neutral
- ⟦{頻繁|ひんぱん}→頻繁：08631_hinpan⟧ (frequent) is an adjective and applies to both positive and negative things
